purpose: Finite post-install availability diagnostic; no alpha or order authority
start: Actual progress.at in the first captured fresh-trading proof for each process
sample: All original native book events whose processedAt falls in [start,start+300000)
clockArithmetic: Original nanosecond UTC parsing; retain request/source/receipt/processed fields and invalid gaps
metrics: book counts by original normalized source
missingOrInvalid: Count explicitly; never infer a fresh unchanged book or market silence
sourceAuthentication: Authenticate original suffix/anchored heads and raw sealed rows before computation
limitations: R25 outcomes were already inspected before this protocol; diagnostic comparison is not preregistered confirmatory evidence
Separate clock-time market windows and startup conditions may differ
A smaller processing delay does not establish more executable edge, fills or profit
newGenerationsDuringNewWindow: Keep original four generations until the comparison window closes; later node-only review is separate
